# Pack: unicore

Unicore UNI binary messages, one kind per message of fixed length, from the
message definitions of `https://github.com/semuconsulting/pyunigps` (`src/pyunigps/unitypes_get.py`) at v0.0.0-fixture, commit `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`.
Public. Generated by `tools/gen/uni2pack.py`; do not edit `pack.def`, this file,
`PROVENANCE.md`, `model/unicore.def` or the vectors by hand.

Status: Built. Generated and checked by the generator's own serializer and codec.

No Unicore document was read: the definitions are pyunigps's BSD-licensed
restatement, read as Python syntax trees.

## The message

`wire bits`, `bit_order lsb`, `word_bytes 1`; hex text. One UNI binary frame
without its sync bytes (0xAA 0x44 0xB5) and its CRC-32; every number is
little-endian. The header is 21 bytes:

| Bytes | Field | In the pack |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | CPU idle | `unicore.header_cpuidle` |
| 1-2 | message ID | per-kind `when` |
| 3-4 | payload length in bytes | per-kind `when` |
| 5, 6 | time reference, time status | `unicore.header_timeref`, `unicore.header_timestatus` |
| 7-8, 9-12 | week, time of week | `unicore.header_wno`, `unicore.header_tow` |
| 13-16, 17, 18, 19-20 | version, reserved, leap seconds, delay | `unicore.header_*` |
| 21 … | payload | the kind's `field` lines |

A framer adds the sync bytes and the CRC before sending and checks them on
receipt: CRC-32 (reflected polynomial 0xEDB88320, initial value 0) over the
sync bytes, the header and the payload, written little-endian after the
payload. That is the item "Layered wires and framing" of `docs/roadmap.md`.

## What is mapped

| Definition type | Transform | Model type |
|---|---|---|
| `U1` … `U8` | `uint` | int |
| `S1` … `S8` | `twos` | int |
| `R4`, `R8` | `f32`, `f64`; with a scale `f32scale`, `f64scale` | float |
| `C<n>` (text of a fixed length) | `ascii` | string |
| an integer with a scale | `uscale` / `sscale` with the scale as an exact fraction | float |
| a bit field (`_bit`) | each named bit group as its own field, from the least significant bit | int |
| a group with a fixed repeat count | its fields once per repeat, `_01`, `_02`, … appended | as the field |
| an unsigned integer or byte field wider than 8 bytes | 8-byte `uint` parts, `_01` … appended | int |

Keys are `unicore.<message>_<field>` in lower case. A scale the source states is
applied; the source states no unit, so the module declares none (`-`).

Scaled fields:

| Kind | Field | Transform |
|---|---|---|
| `fixnav` | `level_01` | `sscale:1/100` |
| `fixnav` | `level_02` | `sscale:1/100` |
| `fixnav` | `drift` | `f32scale:1/128` |
| `fixnav` | `age` | `uscale:1/4` |

### Core keys

None. The position messages (BESTNAV and the others like it) carry `lat` and
`lon` as doubles that pyunigps's own README treats as degrees, and a `datumid`
field that names the datum of each message. The source does not say which
`datumid` value is WGS 84, so no message can be shown to hold WGS 84
coordinates; binding `lat` and `lon` would need that value, and then a gate
(Version 0.17, `if <locator> <value>`) on `datumid`. The height these messages
give is above mean sea level (`hmsl`), not the ellipsoid, so it would not bind
`hae` either.

### `requires`

Each kind requires up to 3 of its own keys, so an entity from another format
selects a kind only when it holds them.

|---|---|---|
| SATS | 1042 | a group repeated by field `numsat` |
| INFO | 37 | a field of type CXXX whose length the payload length gives |
| NOID | - | no message ID in UNI_MSGIDS |

- A message whose length varies: a group repeated by a count field or to the
  end of the payload, or text whose length the payload length gives.
- The sync bytes and the CRC (see The message).

## Vectors

`vectors/rt-<ID>-<kind>.json`: one same-format round trip per kind, the frame
written by a serializer in the generator from sample values.

2 vectors.
